8use crate::third_party::vello_common::coarse::Wide;
9use crate::third_party::vello_common::encode::EncodedPaint;

12use crate::third_party::vello_common::paint::{ImageResolver, Paint};

18pub(crate) trait Dispatcher: Debug + Send + Sync {
19    fn wide(&self) -> &Wide;
20    fn fill_path(
21        &mut self,
22        path: &BezPath,
23        fill_rule: Fill,
24        transform: Affine,
25        paint: Paint,
26        blend_mode: BlendMode,
27        aliasing_threshold: Option<u8>,
28        mask: Option<Mask>,
29        encoded_paints: &[EncodedPaint],
30    );
31    fn stroke_path(
32        &mut self,
33        path: &BezPath,
34        stroke: &Stroke,
35        transform: Affine,
36        paint: Paint,
37        blend_mode: BlendMode,
38        aliasing_threshold: Option<u8>,
39        mask: Option<Mask>,
40        encoded_paints: &[EncodedPaint],
41    );
42    /// Fill a pixel-aligned rectangle with the current paint.
43    fn fill_rect_fast(&mut self, rect: &Rect, paint: Paint, blend_mode: BlendMode, mask: Option<Mask>, encoded_paints: &[EncodedPaint]);
44    fn push_clip_path(&mut self, path: &BezPath, fill_rule: Fill, transform: Affine, aliasing_threshold: Option<u8>);
45    fn pop_clip_path(&mut self);
46    fn push_layer(
47        &mut self,
48        clip_path: Option<&BezPath>,
49        fill_rule: Fill,
50        clip_transform: Affine,
51        blend_mode: BlendMode,
52        opacity: f32,
53        aliasing_threshold: Option<u8>,
54        mask: Option<Mask>,
55        filter: Option<Filter>,
56    );
57    fn pop_layer(&mut self);
58    fn reset(&mut self);
59    fn flush(&mut self, encoded_paints: &[EncodedPaint]);
60    /// PdfCraft patch (1): whether a path was left out of this scene because its coverage was
61    /// full (only the single-threaded dispatcher keeps count).
62    fn coverage_full(&self) -> bool {
63        false
64    }
65    /// PdfCraft patch (1): keep the scene to `max` coverage values (never more than a strip's
66    /// index reaches); the single-threaded dispatcher leaves later paths out past it.
67    fn set_max_coverage(&mut self, _max: usize) {}
68    fn rasterize(
69        &self,
70        buffer: &mut [u8],
71        render_mode: RenderMode,
72        width: u16,
73        height: u16,
74        encoded_paints: &[EncodedPaint],
75        image_resolver: &dyn ImageResolver,
76    );
77    fn composite_at_offset(
78        &self,
79        buffer: &mut [u8],
80        width: u16,
81        height: u16,
82        dst_x: u16,
83        dst_y: u16,
84        dst_buffer_width: u16,
85        dst_buffer_height: u16,
86        render_mode: RenderMode,
87        encoded_paints: &[EncodedPaint],
88        image_resolver: &dyn ImageResolver,
89    );
90}
